messages:
Hannah: Morning team — I pushed a relnotes + changelog draft for the docs site; need a final snippet sweep and one redirect to land before we publish.
Leo: Link?
Hannah: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/branches/relnotes-2865432100
Ivy: Quick scan  saw three small things: 1) C# quickstart uses old client name; 2) a note about tokenizer changes needs clearer user impact; 3) one deep link 404s.
Sam: For C# new pattern is `Redwood.Client.Create()` not `new RedwoodClient()`. I can paste a one-liner.
Vik: Paste please  I'll update the snippets.
Sam: ```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = Redwood.Client.Create(apiKey: Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_KEY"));
```
Ivy: Tokenizer change bullet currently says "tokenization optimized"  can we add a concrete example (shorter tokenized length for emoji-heavy inputs) and migration note for cost-estimates?
Hannah: Good idea. I'll add: "Note: some payloads (emoji, CJK-heavy) may tokenize differently; review cost estimates post-upgrade."
Product: Marketing wants the feature-label for fallback routing to be "preview (opt-in)" across relnotes and banners.
Hannah: Will do.
Leo: Docs Bot, please run a link-check on relnotes-2865432100 branch.
Docs Bot: Link-check queued for branch relnotes-2865432100  ETA ~90s :gear:
Vik: Also include a tiny repro for the embed-stream partial-chunk issue. Use websocat example so users testing locally have another option.
Sam: Repro snippet: ```bash
# reproduce streaming partial chunks with websocat
websocat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1/embeds
# send two short payloads quickly, then close client socket after second frame
```
Ivy: Good  mark the workaround as "temporary: client reconnect on 30s idle" and link to internal issue internal/issue/9610.
Hannah: I'll add that under Known Issues with the repro + link.
Docs Bot: Link-check complete: 1 broken link found (/how-to/prefetch) 404; all others OK. Suggested redirect to /how-to/prefetching.
Leo: I'll open redirect PR and a snippet PR for C# and the tokenizer note. PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5421 and /pull/5422
Hannah: Plan: Leo lands the two PRs, Docs Bot re-checks links, I update marketing label and then we merge + publish tonight. Any objections?
Vik: No blockers from eng-runtime.
Ivy: I'll do a quick pass on wording for tokenizer impact after PRs merge.
Hannah: Thanks all  ping here if any more 404s pop up. :rocket:
